This [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''fluorescent algae''' was discovered in the [[Ragnos Lakes]] region of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4985 BBY]]. Hoping to find a way to use the algae to light [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] structures, [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] leader [[Yaru Korsin]] sent [[Ravilan Wroth]] and his retinue to the region to investigate.
